name: gamma-aminobutyric acid
description: Gamma-aminobutyric acid (CAS 56-12-2 ), widely recognized in procurement and formulation markets as GABA, is a naturally occurring amino acid used across pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, and cosmetic supply chains. It functions as a bioactive ingredient in finished consumer products and as a reference compound or intermediate in life sciences manufacturing. In dietary supplement and functional food manufacturing, it is incorporated into capsules and powders. GABA is frequently used in fortified beverages targeting relaxation and sleep support positioning. Cosmetic formulators use it in anti-aging and skin-smoothing topicals, where its humectant behavior supports moisture retention. Pharmaceutical and biotech applications include use as a biochemical reference standard and a building block in peptide synthesis. It also serves as a component in buffer systems for cell culture media. In flavor research, it contributes to taste-modifying formulations, particularly in products where kokumi or mouthfeel enhancement is a development target. The compound is supplied as a white crystalline powder. Available grades include food-grade, USP , and reagent/analytical grade to meet the distinct documentation requirements of nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, and research buyers. Bulk quantities are standard for industrial formulators, with smaller pack sizes available for laboratory and quality control applications.
